title: Samsung launched a new 200MP camera sensor with DeepPix
description: Reports indicate Samsung has unveiled the ISOCELL HPC, its first sensor featuring DeepPix technology, capable of capturing 16-bit RAW photos.

sections.heading: New Sensor Announcement
paragraphs: According to GSMArena.com, Samsung has unveiled the ISOCELL HPC. The source identifies this as the company's first sensor to feature DeepPix technology.

sections.heading: Camera Capabilities
paragraphs: NewsBytes reports that Samsung's new 200MP camera sensor can capture 16-bit RAW photos. This highlights the advanced imaging capabilities of the new hardware.

sections.heading: Potential Device Integration
paragraphs: PhoneArena has raised the question of whether this development provides the first look at the Galaxy S27 Ultra camera. This suggests the sensor may be intended for future flagship devices.
